items.headline: Man Utd beat Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly in Norway
items.summary: Manchester United won their second pre-season match 5-0 against Rosenborg in Trondheim on Friday, with further fixtures planned against Atletico Madrid, PSG, Leeds United.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans signed from Aston Villa for £35m
items.summary: Belgian midfielder Youri Tielemans completed his transfer to Manchester United from Aston Villa via release clause as a key summer signing.
